Minimum Sq. Ft. (ABOA):  70,000

Maximum Sq. Ft. (ABOA):  112,677

Space Type:  Warehouse, containing 4,502 ABOA SF of Office and office related space. Plus, a Ware yard containing a minimum of 18,360 SF to a maximum 30,000 SF.

Parking Spaces (Total):  Twenty-five (25) to Thirty-five (35)

Parking Spaces (Surface):  Twenty-five (25) to Thirty-five (35)

Parking Spaces (Structured):  None (0)

Parking Spaces (Reserved):  Twenty-five (25) to Thirty-five (35)

Full Term:  15 Years (180 months)

Firm Term:  10 Years (120 months)

Option Term:  N/A

Additional Requirements:

  • Access to loading docks with a dock height of no less than 12' is required.
  • The Ware yard shall have the ability to accommodate a truck (semi-truck up to 53’) turning radius.
  • Minimum Ceiling Height of 24’

Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease.  A fully serviced lease is required.  Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance  floodplain (formerly referred to as “100-year” floodplain).

Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR).  For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B.
